### NEW
- **Smart Storage Terminal**: place it, right-click it, and search every chest, trapped chest, barrel and shulker box within 16 blocks from one screen.
- Results show item icon, name, total quantity and how many containers hold it. Click an item to see every container (number, kind, quantity and coordinates).
- Filters (All, Blocks, Tools, Food, Materials, Redstone, Misc) and four sort modes.
- Withdraw one stack or everything; deposit matching items or your whole inventory (with a confirmation).
- Double chests are counted once. Unloaded chunks are never loaded; a warning shows when part of the area is unloaded.
- `config/smartchests.json`: `searchRadius` (1-32, default 16).
- Developer hook: `SmartChestsApi.ACCESS_CHECK` lets other mods veto access to a container.
